messages:
marta: Heads-up — I found decrypt calls against a customer KMS key from a worker in a different org after yesterday's RBAC role refactor. Could be a policy delta in the new role mappings.
alex: ugh, when did this land? which PR?
ja: that was #1287, merged by infra-team yesterday afternoon. we scoped roles to "project:read" -> "workspace:read" mappings.
marta: PR is likely the cause. audit logs show 3 decrypt events from service-account `svc-batcher@infra` with org_id=org-b, key=projects/rdw/keys/cust-9843. timestamp window 2026-03-19T16:12:05Z..16:14:20Z.
audit-bot: ALERT: unusual_kms_activity detected for key cust-9843, origin org-b, 3 decrypts in 2m. See /internal/audit/1967/cust-9843.
ops-oncall: Can we block these calls while we triage? revoke or deny?
alex: I can push a temporary deny on the role binding to that service account. applying the deny will break batch jobs though. need quick rollback plan.
marta: do it. also add a logging-only policy to capture full headers. run this snippet to find the exact call chain:
```bash
# query internal audit es
curl -sS "https://audit.internal/_search?q=key:cust-9843 AND event:Decrypt" | jq '.hits.hits[] | {ts: ._source.timestamp, actor: ._source.actor, headers: ._source.request.headers}'
```
jia: I pulled the logs — actor is svc-batcher@infra, parent_request contains route: `model/route-lookup` -> then `storage/decrypt`. looks like the routing policy fell back to org-b because of a missing workspace-to-org mapping.
marta: mapping service had a regression: new RBAC role name `workspace.viewer.v2` wasn't mapped to org-scoped deny rules. effectively the allow path bypassed org check. PR #1287 removed an explicit org guard in favor of role inheritance.
ops-oncall: alex, how long to push deny?
alex: ~5m to push a temporary deny binding. I'll attach the rollback steps.
alex: done — deny applied to svc-batcher@infra for key cust-9843. monitoring.
audit-bot: RESOLVED: unusual_kms_activity now low. 0 decrypts in last 5m.
marta: good. next steps: revert the permissive change in #1287 or add an explicit org-guard middleware. I'll open a patch PR.
ja: can we add an eval to keep tests from regressing? gate should include a simulated cross-org decrypt check.
marta: agree — adding an integration test that runs `decrypt` with mismatched org header and expects 403. also need to backfill an alert to detect cross-org decrypt spikes.
ops-oncall: ok to close this thread once PR merged and canary passes.
alex: tagging to 24h follow-up for audit retention and to notify the affected customer. I created incident note: INC-2026-087.
marta: thanks all. leaving the deny in place until PR merged and verified.
